trigger: crew shows mercy or keeps a promise under pressure
consequence: locks in as unshakably loyal; +2 to aid the crew for the rest of the campaign
flavor: Just needs a reason to trust you for good.

trigger: a corporate enemy offers a better deal mid-job
consequence: may leak the plan or flip during The Last Job

trigger: a collector applies pressure between jobs
consequence: may steal from the take to pay a debt

trigger: a crew member is wounded or endangered
consequence: will take a hit meant for another; refuses to abandon crew
flavor: This is the family they never had.

trigger: a chance at a bigger name with a rival crew
consequence: may abandon mid-run for a flashier score
flavor: Loyalty lasts until the spotlight moves.

trigger: an enemy from their lifepath appears on a job
consequence: breaks the plan to pursue revenge
flavor: Some ledgers get settled no matter the cost.

trigger: the crew gives them a second chance
consequence: becomes steadier and braver over the campaign
flavor: Trying to be better than the worst thing they did.

trigger: the run goes sideways and survival is at stake
consequence: cuts and runs, leaving the crew exposed
flavor: Number one was always number one.

trigger: their lifepath lover is leveraged by an outside party
consequence: feeds information out to protect the one they love
flavor: They'd betray anyone but that one person.

consequence: never betrays; morale anchor for the whole crew
flavor: You got lucky with this one. You will never know how lucky.
